summary: Stop auto cleanup at the free space goal

delivery.outcome: Stop automatic disk cleanup stages in fixos auto once the root filesystem free space reaches the requested --free-gb target, skip cleanup when already satisfied, and preserve dry-run preview and unmet-target reporting.
nonGoals: Adding new cleanup candidates or changing dry-run preview semantics.

architecture.decision: Evaluate root free space against target_free_bytes before each cleanup stage in auto_cmd via needs_cleanup() and refresh_free_bytes(), skipping subsequent stages once the target is met while preserving dry-run preview.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit touching fix_cmd.py and test_auto_cleanup.py.

validation.evidence: Tests verify initially satisfied targets skip cleanup, mid-run satisfied targets stop after the stage reaching the goal, dry-run continues previewing, and unmet targets execute all stages and report goal_unmet.
Full test suite and governance gate pass.
